147: Kenshin Himura, also known throughout the anime as Hitokiri Battousai (Battousai the Manslayer) or Himura the Battousai, is the main character of the series Rurouni Kenshin. His original name was Shinta (心太).
148: The primary instructor of the Kamiya Kasshin-Ryū fighting style developed by her late father, Kamiya Koshijirō, Kaoru inherited a small dojo from her father after he was killed during the Seinan War and operates it by herself.
149: Sagara Sanosuke left home at an early age to join the Sekihou Army (Sekihou-tai), leaving behind his father (Kamishimoemon), his mother (Naname), and his younger sister (Uki) who adored him.
150: Yahiko is a samurai descendant. Yahiko's father died during the Battle of Ueno during the Boshin War, slain at the Keneiji Temple. His mother died of syphilis in a brothel to put food on their table not long after giving birth to her son.
151: Takani Megumi is a secondary character in the Rurouni Kenshin series and the main cast's primary physician after her appearance. She is the youngest daughter of Takani Ryūsei, a well-known doctor in Aizu which was an important province supporting the Tokugawa Shogunate.
1238: Shinomori Aoshi was raised a ninja of the Oniwabanshū, who worked for the Shogunate government during the Edo period. He helped to raise Makimachi Misao from childhood as a member of the Oniwabanshū.
1409: Hajime Saitou is loosely based on the real third-squad captain of the Shinsengumi. During the Meiji era, he lived as a police officer under the name of Gorou Fujita. In the Rurouni Kenshin series, he plays the role of Kenshin's old rival and enemy from the Bakumatsu.
2262: Misao is a fairly skilled ninja from the Oniwabanshū clan of onmitsu previously based in Edo. Her weapons of choice are the kunai. Misao is about sixteen years old when she is first introduced, though she appears younger.
2406: The thirteenth successor to the sword art of Hiten Mitsurugi-Ryu, Hiko Seijuro saved young Shinta from marauding bandits who killed his companions.
3402: A genius swordsman of the Shinsengumi and master of the Tennen-rishin ryu sword style. Okita was the captain of Shinsengumi's First Unit. In the OVA, he often fought together with Saito and was involved in the Ikedaya Affair in 1864.
3683: After the death of Yukishiro Tomoe, Himura Kenshin became a free wielding swordsman to protect members of the Ishin Shishi.
6322: Based on the actual captain, Sagara Sōzō (1839 - 1868) was the leader of the Sekihōtai's First Troop. Sanosuke looked up to him greatly; he was, to Sanosuke, the ideal role model.
6326: Komagata Yumi was an oiran, a courtesan (in short the highest rank of prostitute) in Yoshiwara, formerly an akasen. Because of that, she is beautiful, intelligent, dignified, well-cultured, and was brought up in a comfortable life.
10283: Kamatari is a member of Juppongatana who is in love with Makoto Shishio. His weapon of choice is a large scythe with an attached ball and chain, a very heavy weapon. While he has the appears feminine he is in fact a male.
11978: Jinpuu is a master of the art of feng shui. He appears in the later episodes of Rurouni Kenshin.
15026: Houji is Shishio's minion, and, aside from Yumi and Soujirou, he is closest to him. He used to be an official in the Meiji government but lost faith in it when he saw no one in the government worthy of controlling the country.
18777: He is a strong fighter and a talented strategist. He is said to be the only one who can equal the former Oniwabanshū leader in a fight, wielding steel tonfa to block sword blows.
18778: Also known as 'The Sword Hunter', Chou possesses quite a collection of rare and unusual swords, including a long flexible sword he keeps hidden around his waist, and double bladed sword known as a renbatou.
18779: Kurogasa, otherwise known as Udou Jin-e, was a hitokiri during the Revolution, and there is evidence he continued killing people well after the end of the Revolution.
18930: Hannya is a pupil of Aoshi. The village he was born in was poor, so he was abandoned at birth to reduce the number of people to feed.
19093: Sekihara Tae is the 20-something manager of the beef hot pot (gyūnabe, or sukiyaki) restaurant, the Akabeko. She has a twin sister named Sae managing in a similar restaurant called the Shirōbeko in Kyoto.
19094: A waitress at Tae's restaurant, Sanjou Tsubame becomes Yahiko's sweetheart. She was saved by him from the ronin her family worked for as Yahiko stopped them from robbing the Akabeko. She is very shy and soft spoken.
19495: Usui, the Blind Sword, used to be a swordsman working for the shogunate government. However, in a fight against Shishio Makoto, he was blinded.
19496: Fuji is a giant, considered a freak by everyone around him. One day he was attacked and almost killed but the old man Saizuchi found him and took him in.
19499: Iwanbou is a fat oaf who uses his immense size, his strength, and his ability to entrap weapons in his flab. He is very stupid, and, apart from taking part in the battle of Aoiya as well as grinning like an utter idiot, he doesn't say anything, and he doesn't do anything.
20352: Shougo Amakusa was a disciple and nephew of Hyoue Nishida. Shougo’s name at birth was Shougo Muto. After both of his parents were martyred as Christians, Shougo and his sister, Sayo, moved to the continent with Hyoue.
20505: Seikuu Arai is the son of Kenshin's reverse-blade sword maker, Shaku Arai. In defiance to his father creating swords that kill, Seikuu quit forging swords and decided to turn to creating kitchen wares and knives.
21007: Yutaro is a young boy that inherited a HUGE fortune from his parents. His parents had died when he was younger. He appears when Dr. Genzai's sister (she looks just like his brother) is working for Yutaro.
21008: A warrior fighting against the pacification of Japan, Raijuta attempts to build an army of the most powerful bandits to rebel against the new Japanese government. He saves Yutaro, a child of a rich family, in order to acquire the resources to build his army.
23710: Leader of the Jinpu Squad-Defeated by Kenshin Himura/Arrested. Former student of Heihachirou Sasaki. Master of the Hinohakitou Style and it's pinnacle attack, the Shiden Blade.
29847: The father of Shougo and Sayo in Amakusa Arc of the anime.
37690: Real name Sayo Muto, Lady Magdalia is Shogo Amakusa's younger sister. She serves as a holy mother to their crowd of followers and a teacher to the young children.
42039: The doctor and Kamiya Family's family friend. He is the grandfather of Suzume and Ayame. He took Megumi under his wing to train her as a full pledged doctor.
42042: Shura is the captain of the Kairyu Pirates, named after the island where they originated.
42047: A ninja from Kyoto Oniwabansu group.
45571: The leader of the Sanada ninja clan.
48411: Henya Kariwa was a member of the Juppongatana, an organization under Shishio Makoto's orders.
251176: The former commander of the Tokyo Sword Bearing Police.
